♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon has shifted into Libra in Vishakha, moving through your 7th house of partners while Mars continues in Cancer in Ashlesha at the base of your chart and Jupiter shines from Leo in Magha in your 5th. This creates a strong axis between heart, home and partnership. You’re likely to feel more responsive to others’ moods than usual, but also more aware of what kind of support and loyalty you actually want. With the Sun and retrograde Mercury together in Libra as well, conversations with key people can feel fated or overdue.

💼 Career: The emphasis on Libra and your 7th house makes this a day when deals, collaborations and client relationships matter more than solo pushing. A partner or colleague may propose a compromise that’s actually better than your original plan, if you can relax your need to control the process. Mars in your 4th can stir irritation if work decisions disturb your sense of security or family rhythm; rather than reacting, take time to understand everyone’s stakes. Jupiter in the 5th supports bold creative moves—presenting an original idea to a team, or stepping into a more visible role on a project.

❤️ Love: With the Moon, Sun and Mercury all energizing your relationship zone, interactions can be intense, clarifying and sometimes surprising. Old dynamics around fairness or decision‑making may surface for review. If partnered, a practical discussion about how you make choices together—money, schedules, long‑term plans—can deepen mutual respect. Listen carefully; your partner may reveal something they’ve struggled to phrase. If single, you may feel magnetically drawn to someone who balances your fiery directness with grace and tact, possibly met through social or professional circles.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 5th can open doors for speculative or growth‑oriented investments, especially around education, children or creative ventures, but Libra’s influence asks for balanced risk. Agreements with others—profit‑sharing, commissions, retainers—are highlighted. Take the time to read what’s in writing and negotiate terms that reflect everyone’s genuine contribution. Mars in the 4th can correlate with home‑related expenses; invest where it truly improves your living situation, not just to soothe a temporary mood.

🧘 Advice: Let other people’s perspectives widen your view instead of threatening it; cooperation doesn’t dilute your fire when you choose your allies consciously.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The partner who challenges your reflex reactions today is quietly protecting your future self.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through Libra in Vishakha in your 6th house of effort, routines and practical service, while your ruler Venus continues retrograde in late Virgo in Chitra, close to the cusp of your 5th–6th houses. Jupiter in Leo in Magha sits at the root of your chart in the 4th, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha activates your 3rd house of courage and communication. This is a workmanlike, hands‑on day where skill, consistency and small refinements carry big weight.

💼 Career: With so much activation in your 3rd and 6th houses, tasks that involve writing, editing, teaching, customer care or troubleshooting are strongly supported. You may find yourself mediating between people or smoothing a process that has become clumsy. Venus retrograde asks you to revisit a creative solution or style of working that once felt natural but was set aside. Jupiter in the 4th reminds you to protect your emotional baseline—taking on more duties is fine if it still allows for genuine rest and a supportive home environment. Clear, kind communication can defuse a work misunderstanding before it escalates.

❤️ Love: Your focus may lean toward whether your relationships fit smoothly into your everyday life. Grand declarations matter less than whether you feel practically supported and respected. If partnered, small acts—helping with an errand, honoring each other’s schedules, listening without multitasking—mean more than you might think. If single, attraction may spark with someone you regularly interact with in a mundane setting: a colleague, neighbor, or fellow commuter. Pay attention to how you feel in your body around them—relaxed and curious is a good sign.

💰 Money: The 6th‑house Moon often shines a light on how your time and energy translate into income. You may see clearly where an adjustment in workflow could ultimately improve your earnings. With Mars in your 3rd, it’s a good day to chase late payments, clarify terms, or update your professional profile or portfolio. Jupiter in the 4th can point to longer‑term themes around property or living arrangements; for now, focus on stabilizing daily cash flow and trimming wasteful habits that don’t add to your real comfort.

🧘 Advice: Honor the power of modest improvements—your steady hand on the small wheels is quietly redirecting the whole machine of your life.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way someone shows up in the unremarkable hours tells you more than any romantic speech ever will.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha lights up your 5th house of creativity, intelligence, romance and children, while your ruler Mercury retrograde joins the Sun in Libra as well. Venus retrograde in Virgo in Chitra continues to work through your 4th house of home and inner foundations, Mars in Cancer charges your 2nd house of resources and speech, and Jupiter in Leo in Magha opens doors in your 3rd house of learning and networks. Your mind is bright and playful, but there’s also a serious undercurrent about what truly brings you joy.

💼 Career: Today favors tasks where you can think conceptually, design, write, present or teach. You could return to an old idea, pitch or piece of content and suddenly see how to make it sing. Libra’s air energy helps you shape your thoughts into something others can easily receive. Mars in your 2nd gives you the courage to talk about compensation or pricing, but avoid letting financial anxiety color your tone. Jupiter in the 3rd supports skill upgrades: a course, workshop, or mentoring conversation can open a path you hadn’t considered.

❤️ Love: With your 5th house so active, the romantic atmosphere is light, curious and slightly nostalgic. Old crushes or half‑finished flirtations may drift back into your orbit, giving you a chance to respond from who you are now rather than who you were then. If partnered, you benefit from doing something together that’s more playful than productive—games, art, music, or exploring a neighborhood you’ve never visited. If single, social spaces where ideas are exchanged—a class, discussion group, or even online forums—are fertile ground for meeting someone mentally engaging.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd heightens awareness of income and expenses and can nudge you to take bolder action—asking for payment, setting a boundary with someone who assumes your time is free, or increasing your rates for a specific service. Just be sure you’re basing decisions on clear numbers, not on passing moods. Jupiter in the 3rd suggests that small, consistent investments in communication skills and technology can pay off more than flashy moves.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity lead but give your ideas a home—capture them somewhere tangible instead of trusting they’ll return unchanged.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The story you tell about your talents today becomes the script others use to value them.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, has moved into Libra in Vishakha and into your 4th house of home, roots and emotional security, creating a square with Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 1st. Jupiter in Leo in Magha continues to travel through your 2nd house of values and resources, while Venus retrograde in Virgo and Mercury retrograde in Libra bridge your 3rd and 4th houses. Feelings about family, belonging and how much space you’re allowed to take up are likely to be vivid today.

💼 Career: You may feel less inclined toward outward display and more drawn to tending your base of operations—physical workspace, systems, or emotional preparation. If you can, handle tasks from a comfortable environment or focus on planning rather than public performance. Tensions between personal needs and external demands can surface: perhaps a work obligation cuts into family time or vice versa. Rather than silently absorbing the strain, use Mars in your sign to assert a reasonable boundary or renegotiate a deadline. Jupiter in the 2nd supports strategic thinking about your income, including how to stabilize it without burning out.

❤️ Love: The Libra Moon in your 4th highlights balance and fairness in your closest emotional bonds. Old patterns from your family of origin may be easier to see—and therefore soften—today. If partnered, a gentle, honest conversation about what helps you each feel “at home” in the relationship can be healing. This might involve sharing responsibilities differently or adjusting how you spend downtime together. If single, you may notice you’re less drawn to dramatic chemistry and more interested in people who feel emotionally consistent and kind, even if the spark grows slowly.

💰 Money: Jupiter’s steady movement through your 2nd house is a reminder that your earning capacity is expanding, but today’s focus is on feeling safe enough to think long‑term. Review basics: emergency savings, recurring bills, and any subscriptions related to home or comfort. Mars in your 1st can tempt you into impulse purchases as a way to self‑soothe; pause and ask if the purchase genuinely nurtures you or just distracts you.

🧘 Advice: Protect the rituals and spaces that refill you; when your inner “home” is stable, outer negotiations become far less draining.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you let people treat your need for rest today teaches them how to handle your heart tomorrow.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha activates your 3rd house of ideas, siblings and day‑to‑day interactions, while the Sun—your ruler—travels there as well with retrograde Mercury. Jupiter in your own sign in Magha in the 1st keeps your sense of possibility strong, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha stirs your 12th‑house subconscious. Venus retrograde in Virgo in Chitra continues to refine your 2nd‑house values. It’s a mentally active day with an introspective undertone.

💼 Career: Communication is front and center. Presentations, interviews, negotiations and written content all benefit from your natural charisma plus extra clarity from Libra’s air. You may have to revisit a previous conversation or contract; this time, you see nuances around fairness and workload more clearly. Mars in the 12th hints at hidden frustrations—perhaps old disappointments or fears around being overlooked. Use that energy to quietly prepare rather than sabotage yourself with procrastination. Jupiter in your 1st supports stating your intentions boldly, especially if you can back them with concrete examples of your work.

❤️ Love: You’re in a mood to talk things through, but not necessarily in a heavy way. Playful banter, thoughtful messages and shared interests can feel especially bonding. If partnered, an important exchange might happen in transit—on a walk, a drive, or while running errands together—when both of you are slightly distracted and thus more honest. If single, your attraction may be piqued by someone whose words strike you as elegant or unusually balanced, possibly met through short courses, social media or your neighborhood.

💰 Money: Venus moving through your 2nd house continues to ask: does your spending align with the royal standards you hold for yourself? Today’s 3rd‑house focus favors taking care of small but meaningful actions—emailing about an overdue invoice, clarifying terms with a client, comparing plans or rates. Jupiter in the 1st can make you optimistic about future earnings; anchor that optimism by outlining practical steps instead of assuming abundance will arrive without your participation.

🧘 Advice: Share your thoughts generously but remember that not every reaction is a verdict on your worth; let curiosity soften your self‑judgment.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The conversations you initiate now are the bridges your future opportunities will walk across.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha moves through your 2nd house of resources, food and self‑worth, while your ruler Mercury retrograde travels with the Sun in your 2nd as well. Venus retrograde remains in late Virgo in Chitra in your 1st house, sharpening self‑awareness, and Jupiter in Leo in Magha activates your 12th house of retreat and the unconscious. Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha powers up your 11th house of friends and long‑term aims. You’re quietly recalibrating what you value—about money, about support, and about yourself.

💼 Career: With your 2nd house lit up, you may feel compelled to put a more accurate price on your time and skills. Retrograde Mercury suggests revisiting old agreements, job descriptions or rate structures. Perhaps something you accepted as “normal” no longer fits what you now know you can do. Mars in the 11th favors taking initiative in group settings: suggesting a new structure, volunteering to coordinate something important, or stepping away from a project that drains you. Jupiter in the 12th hints that behind‑the‑scenes preparation, spiritual practice or research is feeding your long‑term path more than visible hustle.

❤️ Love: Venus in your sign keeps you finely attuned to how you’re perceived, but today the question is: do your relationships make you feel fundamentally respected? If partnered, practical discussions about shared expenses, contributions and personal priorities can actually deepen intimacy if approached without blame. If single, you may feel less inclined to chase attention and more drawn to connections where your effort is matched and your boundaries are honored. Someone in your wider circle could begin to stand out as a quietly solid option.

💰 Money: This is an excellent day for taking stock—literally and figuratively. Review accounts, subscriptions and small habitual purchases; you might quickly see two or three adjustments that offer significant relief. Mercury retrograde warns against rushed commitments or major new financial contracts, but it strongly favors cleaning up the past. Jupiter in the 12th advises you to be mindful of subtle leaks—fees, forgotten trials, or generous lending that isn’t acknowledged.

🧘 Advice: Let your standards for how you’re treated be informed by reality, not by what you’ve learned to endure; refinement is not the same as self‑erasure.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Each time you choose what truly values you over what merely uses you, your future reorganizes a little more in your favor.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon has entered Libra in Vishakha, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury in your 1st house, while your ruler Venus retrograde in late Virgo in Chitra moves through your 12th. Jupiter in Leo in Magha energizes your 11th house of friends and aspirations, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha sits high in your chart in the 10th. You’re simultaneously visible and introspective—reconsidering how you show up just as the world takes another look at you.

💼 Career: Mars at the top of your chart can bring a surge of responsibility or a situation that demands decisive leadership, even if part of you would rather observe from the background. The Libra stellium in your 1st supports clear, diplomatic action: you can set boundaries or adjust a plan without alienating people if you speak plainly. With Mercury retrograde, expect revisions—documents, strategies or public communications may need a second pass. Venus in the 12th suggests that some of your best insights about your career path will come from quiet reflection, dreams, or time away from constant feedback.

❤️ Love: With the Moon, Sun and Mercury in your sign, others respond strongly to your presence and words. This can highlight both the connections that truly nourish you and those where you feel you’re performing “pleasantness” instead of being real. If partnered, today supports honest, balanced dialogue about how both of you have changed over the past year and what adjustments would help the relationship feel more equal. If single, you may attract people who mirror back the version of yourself you’re currently projecting; be intentional about which facets you put forward.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 11th can bring opportunities through networks, groups or patrons, but may also tempt you into over‑committing your time or funds to communal causes. Consider what’s sustainable rather than driven by guilt or image. Mars in the 10th may trigger expenses tied to status or work image—clothing, tools, travel. Invest in items that truly support your function, not just how you appear.

🧘 Advice: Let your outer grace be anchored in inner truth; it’s okay if some relationships shift when you stop smoothing over every discomfort.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The version of yourself you choose to honor in private today becomes the one the world eventually respects in public.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha travels through your 12th house of rest, endings and the subconscious, while the Sun and retrograde Mercury occupy this hidden zone as well. Mars, your traditional ruler, continues in Cancer in Ashlesha in your 9th house of beliefs and long‑distance matters, and Jupiter in Leo in Magha remains in your 10th house of career and reputation. Venus retrograde in Virgo works through your 11th house of friendships and communities. Your inner landscape is busy, even if you appear calm or even withdrawn.

💼 Career: Outwardly, Jupiter in your 10th keeps growth themes alive—new responsibilities, recognition, or an expanding sense of what’s possible in your vocation. Yet today’s Libra emphasis in the 12th suggests that important pieces are still forming behind the scenes. Confidential discussions, strategic thinking and quiet planning are favored over loud moves. Mars in the 9th can stoke strong opinions; be careful not to push your worldview on colleagues who aren’t ready or receptive. Instead, channel that fire into learning or refining your expertise.

❤️ Love: The 12th‑house Moon often heightens sensitivity to subtle shifts in tone, silence or distance. You may find yourself recalling past relationships or unspoken endings. Rather than interpreting this as a sign to reopen closed doors, treat it as a chance to finally integrate the lessons. If partnered, this is a good day to share dreams, fears or longings that you usually keep tucked away—ideally in a calm, private setting. If single, you might feel content to step back from active pursuit and instead clarify what kind of bond would feel spiritually and emotionally restful to you.

💰 Money: Financially, focus today on invisible structures rather than flashy moves: setting up or reviewing automatic transfers, checking the security of accounts, or mapping out how debts and savings interact over the coming months. Jupiter in the 10th can correlate with growth in professional income; aligning that with a discreet, thoughtful money plan now will help you avoid feeling scattered later. Venus in the 11th asks you to notice how group plans affect your budget—social obligations can add up.

🧘 Advice: Honor your need for quiet even if others don’t immediately understand; your next decisive step depends on this incubation period.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop fighting your own need for retreat, your power stops leaking into battles that don’t matter.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha lights up your 11th house of networks, communities and long‑term visions, while your ruler Jupiter in Leo in Magha activates the 9th house of purpose, learning and horizons. The Sun and retrograde Mercury also travel through Libra, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha intensifies your 8th house of shared resources and psychological depth. Venus retrograde in Virgo continues to refine your 10th‑house public image. This is a day when your future plans, allies and deeper motivations intersect.

💼 Career: You’re well‑positioned to collaborate, brainstorm and fine‑tune big objectives with others. Group meetings, strategic sessions and community‑oriented projects are highlighted. With Venus in your 10th, you’re also reconsidering how you’re known professionally—maybe updating your title, online presence, or the type of roles you say yes to. Mars in the 8th indicates that conversations around funding, investment, or shared responsibilities can be emotionally charged; lean on Jupiter’s perspective to stay focused on mutual benefit rather than fear.

❤️ Love: Friendship and romance may blend today. Someone in your wider circle or community might start to feel more significant, or an existing partner could become more involved in your social or ideological world. If partnered, planning for the future together—travel, studies, or a shared project—can re‑ignite connection. If single, you might be drawn to people who share your aspirations or philosophical outlook rather than purely physical attraction.

💰 Money: The 8th‑house Mars suggests activity in joint finances, loans, inheritances or long‑term commitments. This is a good day to clarify expectations in shared arrangements, especially around who contributes what and on what timeline. The 11th‑house Moon supports thinking about long‑range goals: retirement, large purchases, or collective ventures. Avoid making large commitments solely out of excitement or peer pressure; let your 9th‑house Jupiter check if they align with your deeper beliefs.

🧘 Advice: Align your ambitions with the people who genuinely support your growth; the right company will amplify your fire, not contain it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The invitations you accept now quietly decide which future rooms you’ll be standing in.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha climbs through your 10th house of career and public role, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury there, while Saturn—your ruler—holds steady in Pisces in Uttara Bhadrapada in your 3rd. Jupiter in Leo in Magha moves through your 8th house of shared resources, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha occupies your 7th house of partnerships. Venus retrograde in Virgo in Chitra activates your 9th house of beliefs and higher learning. Responsibility, visibility and long‑term meaning are braided tightly today.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for clarifying your professional direction and adjusting how you’re perceived. Reviews, performance conversations or public interactions may carry extra weight. With Mercury retrograde, some of this may involve revisiting earlier decisions or renegotiating terms. Saturn in your 3rd reminds you to choose your words carefully—emails, messages and casual comments could travel further than expected. Mars in the 7th can bring both support and friction via partners, clients or collaborators; assertive but balanced dialogue will serve you better than silent resentment.

❤️ Love: Relationship dynamics today are closely tied to questions of respect and shared purpose. If partnered, you may need to discuss how work responsibilities are affecting your time and availability. Being transparent about pressures you’re under can prevent misinterpretation as disinterest. If single, you might feel drawn to people who are serious about their path and capable of standing beside you in public, not just in private moments.

💰 Money: Jupiter in the 8th continues to emphasize themes of restructuring shared finances, debts, or contractual obligations. Today’s Libra focus in your 10th suggests some of these discussions could be linked to your employment or business relationships—bonuses, commissions, contract renewals. Venus in the 9th favors spending on meaningful learning or travel that broadens your perspective, but Saturn advises you to plan rather than leap.

🧘 Advice: Take your authority seriously without armoring your heart; you can be both principled and adaptable when circumstances shift.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The standard you quietly hold yourself to at work today is the one others will eventually trust you for.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha activates your 9th house of wisdom, travel and worldview, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury there, while Saturn in Pisces in Uttara Bhadrapada continues its measured work in your 2nd house of resources and values. Jupiter in Leo in Magha traverses your 7th house of partnerships, and Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha powers your 6th house of work and health routines. Venus retrograde in Virgo in Chitra moves through your 8th house of depth and shared assets. Big‑picture questions are woven into very practical concerns today.

💼 Career: You’re likely to be thinking about the “why” behind your work. Is your current path aligned with your ethics and hunger for growth? The Libra stellium in your 9th supports conversations with mentors, exploring courses, or revisiting plans for travel or certification. Mars in the 6th gives you energy to tackle demanding tasks, but can also produce impatience with inefficiency or unfair distribution of labor. Jupiter in the 7th points toward help and opportunity via collaborators; seek out those who share your principles, not just your goals.

❤️ Love: Partnerships are under Jupiter’s magnifying glass, but today the focus is on whether your beliefs, backgrounds or life directions are compatible. If partnered, discussions about future plans—where to live, how to handle cultural or philosophical differences—can be fruitful if you approach them with curiosity rather than a need to win. If single, you may feel pulled toward people from different cultures or educational paths whose perspective widens your own.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd keeps nudging you toward sober, sustainable money habits, and Venus in the 8th asks you to refine how you handle intimacy around finances. This might mean setting clearer boundaries in shared spending, or learning more about how certain investments actually work. The 9th‑house Moon is favorable for financial education—books, webinars, or advice from a trusted expert—rather than dramatic moves based on a hunch.

🧘 Advice: Let your ideals inform your daily choices instead of hovering like distant theories; integrity becomes real when it reaches your calendar and your wallet.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The belief you act on today—no matter how small the act—will shape who you recognize as “your people” tomorrow.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Libra in Vishakha travels through your 8th house of shared resources, emotional intensity and transformation, joining the Sun and retrograde Mercury there. Your traditional ruler Jupiter in Leo in Magha moves through the 6th house of service and health, while Saturn in Pisces in Uttara Bhadrapada continues its sobering transit through your 1st house. Mars in Cancer in Ashlesha energizes your 5th house of creativity and romance, and Venus retrograde in Virgo in Chitra activates your 7th house of partnerships. This is a day of deep clarifications around what you give, what you receive, and what you truly want.

💼 Career: The 6th and 8th houses both emphasized suggests a focus on problem‑solving with others. Complex projects, shared responsibilities and behind‑the‑scenes tasks may demand your attention. You’re well‑placed to spot where arrangements are murky or imbalanced and to propose more equitable structures. With Mercury retrograde, take extra care with confidential information and double‑check any figures you share. Mars in the 5th can help you inject fresh creativity into work, perhaps by framing a tough issue in a new way or designing a more engaging solution.

❤️ Love: Relationship dynamics may feel more intense, but also more honest. Topics around trust, commitment, intimacy or money could come up—not necessarily as conflict, but as necessary maintenance. Venus in your 7th supports graceful negotiation if you stay anchored in your own worth rather than in fear of loss. If partnered, choose one sensitive topic and approach it gently, with a willingness to listen as much as speak. If single, you may feel drawn to people who are emotionally transparent and unafraid of depth, but take your time discerning between genuine vulnerability and drama.

💰 Money: Shared finances, loans, inheritances, or debts are highlighted. This is a solid day to list everything out, understand terms, and decide what needs to be adjusted. Jupiter in the 6th favors gradual improvement through consistent effort—setting up a realistic repayment plan, tidying paperwork, or renegotiating one specific obligation. Avoid making secrecy‑based money decisions; Libra’s influence rewards openness and fairness.

🧘 Advice: Let deeper conversations be an opportunity to stand firmly in who you’re becoming, rather than slipping back into old patterns to keep the peace.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you hold kindly but firmly today can turn an old source of anxiety into a new source of strength.
